name: shadcn/ui Button adaptation
adaptation: Native JSX and role-token CSS replace Slot, class-variance-authority, cn and Tailwind utilities. Preserve the supplied content and event handlers.
css: #__SECTION__ :where([data-markora-component="shadcn:button"]){display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,6px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font:inherit;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}#__SECTION__ :where([data-markora-component="shadcn:button"]:hover){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 88%,var(--paper));box-shadow:0 3px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 12%,transparent)}#__SECTION__ :where([data-markora-component="shadcn:button"]:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}#__SECTION__ :where([data-markora-component="shadcn:button"]:disabled){opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#__SECTION__ :where([data-markora-component="shadcn:button"]){transition:none}}
